verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a centralized rule system for defining and enforcing engineering standards, applied automatically to every pull request it reviews, and Rule Miner can generate rules from PR history. The evidence does not show that rules are authored in plain natural language, or that they run as pass/fail pre-merge checks rather than as review findings. missing for 10: explicit plain-language custom check authoring, documented pass/fail merge-gating check semantics, examples like 'docs updated'/'tests cover new paths', independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I define custom agentic pre-merge checks in plain language — 'docs updated', 'tests cover new paths' — that run on every PR
